info.name: Factset Analytics Datastore About Size API
Factset Return Issue Size Data for a List of Fixed Income Securities.

params.name: ids
params.description:
List of Fixed Income Security identifiers. Supported symbol types include CUSIP, SEDOL, ISIN, and FactSet Security Permanent Identifier (-S).

**ID LIMIT = 250** *per request*.

items.docs: Returns Issue Size data for the Fixed Income security.
